usageGuidelines: Use this before market SPECTRA when the user needs the preserved numeric factor evidence.
Use mode=full only when the user needs raw factor inputs, vectors, or lineage.
Do not present these rows as trading advice; they are market-structure telemetry.

description: Use this read-only tool to retrieve Coinbase INTX perp market-factor history assembled from persisted recorder evidence. It returns venue-pure calculation-history rows with contract identity, ATLAS-shaped factor fields, deltas, quality state, and optional full market inputs or lineage. Parameters: optional product or underlying_ticker filters, source_date or source_date_from/source_date_to, mode=compact|full, limit, and offset. Behavior: read-only and idempotent with no destructive side effects; it does not fetch live exchange data on demand, place trades, or mutate recorder state.

limit.description: Maximum calculation-history rows to return. Defaults to 25 and is capped at 100 through MCP.

mode.description: Optional response mode: compact or full.

product.description: Optional Coinbase INTX product_id or contract_symbol filter, for example AI-PERP-INTX.

source_date.description: Optional exact source date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_from.description: Optional inclusive source-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_to.description: Optional inclusive source-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

underlying_ticker.description: Optional underlying ticker filter, for example AI or COIN50.
